name: c4c-workspace
description: Typed tools, reviewable API integrations and native Workflow SDK workflows.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/workflow-tsconfig.json
scripts.test:codegen: npm run build && C4C_CODEGEN_TEST=1 node --test tests/codegen.test.mjs
scripts.workflow:setup: npm run build && npm --prefix examples/workflows install
